summary: Review #2 covers fixes addressing external reviewer berendt's 6 warnings and 2 info items. All feedback was addressed cleanly: documentation requeue interval corrected from 30s to 15s (W-001), dead helper driveFullReconciliationWithPolicy removed (W-005), propagation policy documented as intentional Background (W-003), backoffLimit:2 divergence documented (W-004), failure message caching added to avoid repeated Pod list calls (W-006), and condition type extracted to conditionTypePolicyValidReady constant (I-001). Missing E2E test (W-002) was explicitly deferred as non-blocking per the external review. All unit tests pass, go vet clean, no new lint issues.
